links.outcome: Readability grade level of LLM patient education responses on low back pain
links.effect: Responses were 'difficult to read': Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level mean 12.39, Flesch Reading Ease mean 19.55, Gunning Fog 13.95, Coleman-Liau 17.46, SMOG 11.04.
links.quote: Readability analysis indicated that DeepSeek's responses were overall "difficult to read", with Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (mean 12.39, SD 1.91), Flesch Reading Ease Scale (mean 19.55, Q1 12.94, Q3 29.78), Gunning Fog Index (mean 13.95, SD 2.61), Coleman-Liau Index (mean 17.46, SD 2.30), and SMOG Index (mean 11.04, SD 1.37).

links.outcome: Hallucinated references in generative AI patient education responses
links.effect: 9 instances (14.8%) of hallucinated references; supporting rated moderate, most references from authoritative platforms.
links.quote: References Assessment identified 9 instances (14.8%) of hallucinated references, while Supporting was rated as moderate, with most references sourced from authoritative platforms.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of DeepSeek-R1 answering common low back pain patient education questions, assessed for readability, PEMAT-P, and clinician-evaluated accuracy/hallucination.
